clusters.label: Surprise Machines
clusters.title: Curatorial Agents
clusters.description: Handing algorithms a share of curatorial agency over the Harvard Art Museums’ 230,000 objects. What a collection shows, and who decides.

clusters.label: Peirce Manuscripts
clusters.title: Peirce Manuscripts
clusters.description: Digitizing and interpreting thousands of hand-drawn diagrams with vision-language models. Machines learn to read what only scholars once could.

clusters.label: Covid
clusters.title: Covid-19 Cartography
clusters.description: Collecting and giving form to the work of the scientists who tracked the pandemic. A global crisis becomes something we can look at.

clusters.label: Analogous City
clusters.title: Analogous City
clusters.description: Aldo Rossi’s 1976 collage of the city of memory, restaged across archives, museums, and installations. A modernist monument returns for the digital age.

clusters.label: Représentation
clusters.title: Mapping Science
clusters.description: Turning conferences into networks of authors linked by a shared vocabulary. A field takes shape before your eyes.

clusters.label: Affinity
clusters.title: Mapping Affinities
clusters.description: Visualizing the quiet ties that draw researchers toward one another. A way of seeing what holds a community together.

clusters.label: Thesaurus
clusters.title: Controlled Vocabularies
clusters.description: Thesauri for organizing scientific and library collections, from a European Commission retrieval system to the semantic web. The groundwork before visualization.
